verdict.rationale: The evidence pack has nothing on how Wrike performs in large workspaces or whether task or item caps apply. Mentions of a 'rate-limit-friendly design' and the Batch API concern API call throughput. They do not cover workspace scale or item limits, so they are adjacent and earn no credit.

support.subject: As an engineer, I know how the product performs and whether item caps apply in workspaces with tens of thousands of tasks
